physical: Angular momentum is moment of inertia times angular velocity (the rotational definition), and is conserved when no external torque acts.
reflected_sentence: The frozen vocabulary supplies no complete reflection of this definition.
rule_reason: The definition and conservation statement keep their shape; the resistance carried by moment of inertia is not itself a stated cost.
closing: The rule decides keeps without a judgment call, but the vocabulary cannot express the relation. In this file ∅ marks an absent partner, not a proposed nonphysical quantity; formula operators are retained without inventing partners. The interpretation fragments identify only legal condition words and do not constitute a successful relational interpretation. Angular momentum cannot silently be replaced by momentum.
